mapper.insert: insert into trade_event_outbox ( event_id, order_id, biz_type, biz_id, event_type, routing_key, from_status, to_status, remark, send_count, send_status, last_error, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{eventId}, #{orderId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{eventType}, #{routingKey}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{remark}, #{sendCount}, #{sendStatus}, #{lastError}, #{createTime}, now() ) on duplicate key update update_time = now()
mapper.select: select id, event_id, order_id, biz_type, biz_id, event_type, routing_key, from_status, to_status, remark, send_count, send_status, last_error, create_time, update_time from trade_event_outbox where send_status in (0, 2) or (send_status = 4 and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)) order by id asc limit #{limit}

select id, event_id, order_id, biz_type, biz_id, event_type, routing_key, from_status, to_status, remark, send_count, send_status, last_error, create_time, update_time from trade_event_outbox where send_status = #{sendStatus} order by update_time desc, id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update trade_event_outbox set send_status = 4, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and ( send_status in (0, 2) or (send_status = 4 and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)) )
update trade_event_outbox set send_count = send_count + 1, send_status = 1, last_error = null, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and send_status = 4
update trade_event_outbox set send_count = send_count + 1, send_status = 2, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and send_status = 4
update trade_event_outbox set send_count = send_count + 1, send_status = 3, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and send_status = 4
